title: FirmwareCommand
description: Guardian -> hub, published on <root>/cmd/fw/<hub_id>, QoS 1, not retained, guardian-signed (K3). Follows the signed-command pattern of calibration_command.schema.json: the Ed25519 signature covers the JCS form of every field except signature/key_id (interfaces/crypto.md). The guardian signs only after check_firmware_eligibility (opengrid.guardian.firmware_check) passes. (epoch, seq) is strictly increasing per hub (K6); a hub rejects a pair that does not exceed the last one it accepted, and any command outside [issued_at, expires_at). The hub reports progress on <root>/ack/fw/<hub_id> (firmware_status.schema.json). New 2026-09-26 (R3.1, owner decision: firmware updates from the console).

command_id.description: One per attempt; a retry is a new command_id with a fresh (epoch, seq).

action.description: ROLLBACK installs target_version, the hub's previous catalogued version, on operator request.

from_version.description: The version the orchestrator believed the hub was running when the command was issued (informational).

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the firmware image from the catalogue. The hub refuses to install an image whose hash differs (HASH_MISMATCH, terminal).

hardware_revision.description: The hardware revision the catalogue entry was validated for; a hub of another revision refuses (HARDWARE_INCOMPATIBLE, terminal).

expires_at.description: Lease: the hub must accept the command before this instant, else it is EXPIRED and the orchestrator retries with a fresh command.
